mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_chat_message ( ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, SENDER_GROUP, RECEIVE_GROUP, MESSAGE, CREATED_AT, IS_READ ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{senderGroup}, #{receiveGroup}, #{message}, NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, SENDER_GROUP, RECEIVE_GROUP, MESSAGE, CREATED_AT, IS_READ, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS time FROM tb_chat_message WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
